title: QAFE$^2$: Quantum accelerated multiscale finite element analysis
summary: The computational cost of concurrent multiscale finite element methods is dominated by the repeated solution of microscopic representative volume element (RVE) problems at macroscopic quadrature points. In this work, we introduce a quantum-classical framework for multiscale finite element analysis (QAFE$^2$) that leverages quantum parallelism to fundamentally alter the scaling of RVE-based homogenisation.
